purpose: Exploratory sensitivity analysis of saved predictions only; no attack generation, model inference, or target gradients.
limitations: Only three existing BSR attack seeds are available. Seed resampling is exploratory and is not a substitute for more independent attack seeds or a fresh held-out evaluation.
These intervals do not replace the original intervals and must not be described as a formal correction or as definitive more reliable final confidence intervals.
Results remain conditional on the fixed data/model choices. Full1000 and new800 overlap; new800 excludes pilot200 but does not constitute a fresh target model.
Batch resampling reflects shared per-batch BSR transforms in this implementation; only original nonempty batches in the selected subset are resampled.

method.clusters: Original final_ids position // 20; retain nonempty clusters in each subset; resample K clusters with replacement.
method.seed_resampling: Resample three whole BSR attack seeds with replacement, one common seed-weight vector across all resampled batches in a replicate; independent of cluster resampling. MI remains one fixed deterministic outcome vector.
method.estimator: Difference between BSR mean clean-correct attack success and MI clean-correct attack success; recalculate clean-correct denominator for every cluster bootstrap replicate.
method.interval: 2.5th/97.5th percentile of 5000 bootstrap estimates; no multiplicity correction.
method.shared_draws: Draws shared across comparisons within each subset; independent streams for batches and seeds and between subsets.
